children: Expands Renasant’s West Tennessee Franchise with over $900M in Low-Cost, Core Deposits
TUPELO, Miss., Oct. 27, 2026
-- Renasant Corporation

(“Renasant”) and Commercial Holding Company (“Commercial”), the parent company of Commercial Bank & Trust Company (“Commercial Bank”), jointly announced today that they have entered into a definitive agreement and plan of merger, pursuant to which Commercial will merge with and into Renasant (the “Merger”). Under the terms of the merger agreement, Commercial shareholders will receive 0.8798 shares of Renasant common stock for each share of Commercial common stock, or approximately 2.64 million shares of Renasant common stock in the aggregate. Coupled with a special cash dividend of approximately $35.7 million to be paid by Commercial to its shareholders prior to closing, the aggregate transaction value is approximately $142 million, based on the RNST 10-day average closing price of $40.29 as of October 26, 2026. Immediately following the Merger, Commercial Bank will merge with and into Renasant Bank. The Merger has been unanimously approved by each company’s board of directors and is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027. Completion of the transaction is subject to customary closing conditions, including the receipt of required regulatory approvals and the approval of Commercial shareholders.

Headquartered in Paris, Tennessee, and chartered in 1877, Commercial Bank operates nine full-service branches in Paris, Union City, Jackson and Memphis, Tennessee. As of September 30, 2026, Commercial Bank had approximately $1.1 billion in total assets, $648 million in total loans and $983 million in total deposits. Complementing its banking franchise, Commercial Bank’s trust and wealth management business has approximately $1.2 billion in assets under management. The Merger will create a Southeastern banking franchise with approximately $28.6 billion in total assets, $20.4 billion in total loans and $22.6 billion in total deposits, based on financial data as of September 30, 2026. In Tennessee, the combined company will operate 28 branches with approximately $2.6 billion in deposits.

“For nearly 150 years, Commercial Bank has built a reputation across West Tennessee for exceptional service and deep community relationships – values that are central to who we are at Renasant,” said Renasant President and CEO, Kevin Chapman. “This partnership strengthens our presence in Memphis and provides solid, long-tenured deposit and wealth relationships throughout West Tennessee. We look forward to welcoming Commercial Bank’s employees, customers and shareholders to Renasant and to building on the foundation that Mott and his team have established.”
Roy Molitor “Mott” Ford, Jr., Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Commercial, is expected to join Renasant in a market executive role following the completion of the Merger.

“For generations, Commercial Bank & Trust has been committed to the people, families and businesses of West Tennessee. As our board considered the best path forward for our shareholders, associates and customers, Renasant stood out as the right partner – a relationship-driven Southeastern bank whose culture mirrors our own, with the products, capabilities and balance sheet to serve our customers as they grow. We are excited for our customers, associates and shareholders to experience our next chapter as part of Renasant,” said Ford.

Keefe, Bruyette & Woods, A Stifel Company, is serving as Renasant’s exclusive financial advisor and rendered a fairness opinion to Renasant’s board of directors, and Phelps Dunbar LLP is serving as its legal advisor. Olsen Palmer LLC is serving as exclusive financial advisor and rendered a fairness opinion to Commercial’s board of directors, and Alston & Bird LLP is serving as its legal advisor.

ABOUT RENASANT CORPORATION:

Renasant Corporation is the parent of Renasant Bank, a 122-year-old financial services institution. Renasant has assets of approximately $27.5 billion and operates 278 banking, lending, mortgage and wealth management offices throughout the Southeast and offers factoring and asset-based lending on a nationwide basis. Additional information is available on Renasant’s website: www.renasant.com.
ABOUT COMMERCIAL HOLDING COMPANY:

Commercial Holding Company, headquartered in Paris, Tennessee, is the parent company of Commercial Bank & Trust Company. Chartered in 1877, Commercial Bank has operations in West Tennessee. Additional information is available on Commercial Bank’s website: www.cbtcnet.com.

Copies of the proxy statement/prospectus, when available, may also be obtained free of charge by requesting them by mail at Commercial Holding Company, 101 North Poplar Street, Paris, Tennessee 38242, Attention: Corporate Secretary.
PARTICIPANTS IN THE SOLICITATION

Renasant and Commercial and certain of their respective directors and executive officers may be deemed, under SEC rules, to be participants in the solicitation of proxies from the shareholders of Commercial in respect of the proposed transaction. Information about Renasant’s directors and executive officers is available in Renasant’s proxy statement dated March 18, 2026, for its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, filed with the SEC on March 18, 2026, and other documents filed by Renasant with the SEC. Other information regarding the persons who may be deemed participants in the proxy solicitation and a description of their direct and indirect interests, by security holdings or otherwise, will be contained in the proxy statement/prospectus and other relevant materials to be filed with the SEC regarding the proposed transaction when they become available. Investors should read the proxy statement/prospectus carefully when it becomes available before making any voting or investment decisions. You may obtain free copies of these documents from Renasant or Commercial as indicated above.
